what: A PR can declare `landing: "self"`, PASS check_pr_landing as `declared_self_land`, go green, and then NEVER MERGE -- silently, with nothing red and nobody owed. MEASURED 2026-10-02 on PR #15490 (branch `chore/breakout-cap-round-row-landed`): all 4 checks green at 08:27:44Z, `check_pr_landing.py` -> `state=declared_self_land`, the per-branch merge-slot claim and `.github/pr-automerge-requests/<slug>.txt` both committed -- and still unmerged 24+ minutes later. CAUSE: `.github/workflows/claude-pr-automerge.yml` is the ONLY workflow in the repo that can merge a PR on green (grepped all of .github/workflows for enablePullRequestAutoMerge / mergePullRequest / `gh pr merge` / a pulls/*/merge call: the only other hits are pr-automerge-disable.yml and r4-demotion-gate.yml, which is workflow_dispatch-only), and it fires on `push` with `branches: ["claude/**"]`. A branch named anything else -- `chore/**`, `fix/**`, `research/**`, `scratch/**`, all of which exist on origin today -- cannot trigger it at any time, for any diff. THE ASYMMETRY: check_pr_landing.py::branch_slug() already strips a leading `claude/` and its own docstring says it uses the 'same derivation claude-pr-automerge.yml uses, so the two agree' -- so the guard KNOWS about the prefix and uses it only to compute a filename, never to refuse a self-land declaration on a branch the trigger cannot reach. The declaration is validated; the ROUTE is not. WHY IT MATTERS more than one stuck PR: `self` vs `hold` is how this repo distinguishes 'lands itself, no human needed' from 'a human merges'. A self-land that silently never fires is the worst of both -- it reads as handled on every surface (green CI, a passing landing guard, no operator-owed row) while the work sits unmerged, which is precisely the class CLAUDE.md calls out as 'merged != deployed != observed' failing one step earlier, at NOT-merged-but-looks-landed. PROPOSED FIX (one guard rule, Tier-1): check_pr_landing.py REFUSES `landing: "self"` on a branch that does not match the automerge trigger's own branch filter, naming the remedy (rename the branch to `claude/<name>`, or declare `landing: "hold"` and say who merges). Read the filter from the workflow rather than hardcoding it, so the two cannot drift -- the same reason branch_slug() exists. || lane CI-AUTOMERGE (session_01MD7v8mG8doHqFYuTbsceQM) 2026-10-04: Same root and same proposed patch as PI-20260929-AQRK6CL1-0001: widen the claude-pr-automerge.yml push filter to every branch except main and automation/**.
